title: Diagnosis of cervical lymph node metastasis with thyroid carcinoma by deep learning application to CT images.
summary: Ablation/testing reported improved AP50 and diagnostic performance for CT-based lymph-node detection/classification. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
ai_technology: An improved Faster R-CNN detected cervical lymph nodes on CT and an attention residual network classified metastatic status.
organization: Second Affiliated Hospital of Zhejiang University School of Medicine

evidence.tested: Ablation/testing reported improved AP50 and diagnostic performance for CT-based lymph-node detection/classification.
evidence.unknown: External replication, causal effects and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
evidence.ai_role: An improved Faster R-CNN detected cervical lymph nodes on CT and an attention residual network classified metastatic status.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
